technical.summary: Short-term overbought conditions (RSI-9, Stoch, Williams %R) conflict with bearish stochastic cross, price below intermediate moving averages, and Ichimoku cloud positioning; lacks confluence for high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: ADSK shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, no government contracts, and earnings arriving in 63 days creating elevated event risk.

sentiment.summary: No congressional signal; market in fear state (42/100) with bearish sentiment (35.4%) slightly exceeding bullish (32.8%), creating mild contrarian opportunity, but lack of recent news data and stale congressional activity (142+ days) limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (403.2), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising USD pressuring multinational earnings, with earnings event 63 days out adding binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term overbought RSI-9 (6.0-6.5 range) near support at 204.12 creates potential mean-reversion bounce opportunity in fear-zone market sentiment.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, rising USD), price below both 50-SMA and 200-EMA, bearish stochastic cross, Ichimoku below cloud, zero momentum confirmation, and high earnings risk in 63 days make this a structurally weak entry with unfavorable risk/reward.

decision.entry_rationale: Price at support (204.12) with RSI-9 overbought creates theoretical mean-reversion setup, but macro environment and technical structure are fundamentally broken.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis (403.2), flat yield curve recession signal, and earnings binary event in 63 days create severe downside risk that far outweighs any bounce potential.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bearish conviction
decision.portfolio_note: Already 66 positions in Information Technology sector; adding ADSK increases concentration risk in high-volatility sector during macro stress.
